card.name: Asterisks and tildes after doses
card.fires_on: Footnote marks such as * and ** or an approximate sign ~ placed right after a dose, volume or table heading in drug dosing text. Also the word Table starting a table caption.

modes.label: Footnote asterisk
modes.description: An asterisk or double asterisk attached to a table heading, value or dose to flag a footnote.
modes.example: Table 1. Preparation of Deferoxamine Mesylate for Injection Prior to Administration<< *>>Intravenous route of administration requires further

modes.label: Approximate sign
modes.description: A tilde or parenthesis with tilde after a quantity, introducing an approximate amount.
modes.example: Administer atropine sulfate<< (~>>15 mcg/kg) or gly

modes.label: Table caption
modes.description: The word Table opening a numbered table right after a sentence ends.
modes.example: [seeWarnings and Precautions (5.1) andDrug Interactions (7.1)].<<Table>> 1: Rosuvastatin Tablets
